Options

Options opens the original Options screen of each game, from the main menu or the game menu. Each game keeps its own settings.

Original options

These work as in the games: autosave, faster map movement, animated objects, ambient sounds, hero voices, the tutorial, spells in automatic combat, the Automatic camera and Automatic camera dynamics (how often close-ups happen), what is shown in battle (Combat phases, Power/toughness values, Abilities icons, Attacking/blocking order), camera speeds, gamma and reversed stereo. A few options are kept but have no effect yet.

Remake settings

Remake settings… is available on the Options screen and in the Etherlords II Esc menus on maps and in battle.

Graphics

SettingWhat it does
RendererCompatibility (the default) runs on more computers. Forward+ (Vulkan) is needed for path tracing. Restart now restarts the game with the chosen renderer.
Path-traced lightingReal shadows, sky light, light bounced between surfaces, and light from fire and spells, on maps and in battles. Needs Forward+ and a graphics card with ray tracing. It costs about 2–3 ms a frame on a fast card. F7 switches it during play. The line under it says whether your computer can use it.
Show light onlyShows the traced light without textures (Shift+F7).
Anti-aliasingSmoother edges in 3D: automatic, off, 2× or 4×.
SharpeningSharpens 3D textures. Choose off (default), light, or strong. Off matches the soft textures of the original games.
ShadowsShadows of figures in battles and of trees, rocks and buildings on maps.
Soft shadowsSofter shadow edges. Off at first.
Terrain detailSubtle texture and relief on map ground and fine grain on battle ground. Off at first.
Enhanced waterReflected scenery, animated ripples, and soft shoreline foam on the adventure map. Bog water has gentler ripples. In Etherlords II, rain adds rings to the water while Map weather is enabled. Off at first.
Map weatherRain, snow and other weather on adventure maps.
Combat bloodBlood in battles.

Audio

SettingWhat it does
Music, Ambience, EffectsVolumes. Ambience is the remake's own background sound of maps and battles.

Interface

SettingWhat it does
MoviesOff, original size or fit to the screen.
Map tooltips on hoverEtherlords II map tooltips without a right click.
Remake helper overlayThe remake's readouts, hints and shortcut buttons over the original screens. Off at first.
Frame rate counterFrames per second in the top right corner. Off at first.
Discord activityShows in the Discord desktop app which game you play and whether you are in the menus, on a map or in a battle. Nothing else is shared. On at first.

On the Hotkeys tab, choose an edition and select a shortcut to change it. Press a key or key combination, or press Esc to cancel. Reset defaults restores the selected edition’s shortcuts for battle, maps and shops.

At the bottom, Export log… saves a log with system information for a problem report, and Game files… adds, switches or removes a game: see Installing the game files.

Leave the heavier settings (path tracing, soft shadows, terrain detail, 4× anti-aliasing) off on devices where they slow the game down.
